description: Return remaining VA hours, capRoom, and whether a new cap can be filed. Also returns the calls wallet: balance_cents is spendable after open holds, wallet_cents is that amount plus holds_cents, and holds_cents is the sum of unsettled holds. addFundsUrl is POST /api/v1/billing/add-funds and this read

name: delegate_task
description: Call get_balance first, then confirm with the user before sending (real hours) unless they already said to send it. Delegate a task to a real human virtual assistant when the AI cannot complete it autonomously. Use this for phone calls, owner-authorized login or captcha steps (never send passwords o

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: Detailed context, instructions, and constraints (max 8000 chars). Never include passwords, OTP codes, recovery keys, cookies, or API keys.

arguments.name: dueDate
arguments.desc: Optional human-readable due date (e.g. EOD Friday).

arguments.name: sourceAgent
arguments.desc: Optional calling-agent label for the audit trail (e.g. grok-bot).

arguments.name: maxHours
arguments.desc: Spend cap in hours (default 0.5). VA/AM stop and ask before exceeding. Actual tracked time is billed, not this cap. Max 8.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required. A repeat returns the original task.

name: list_tasks
description: List recently delegated tasks for this account (id, title, status, short result). awaitingCustomerConfirm true means the delivery is done and the human must confirm, cancel, or reopen. amNote is the delivery note and deliverableLinks are https links from that note. pending and in_progress omit custo

name: get_task
description: Get the current status, title, completion timestamp, and full result notes for a specific delegated task. awaitingCustomerConfirm true means ask the human, then confirm_task, cancel_task, or reopen_task. amNote is the AM or VA note. deliverableLinks lists https links. Stop when status is completed,

name: confirm_task
description: Accept a delivery that is awaitingCustomerConfirm. Settles tracked hours, releases the board and ledger hold, and marks the task completed. If the human does not respond, the job confirms itself after 3 days. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required. A repeat of the same key returns the same

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required.

name: cancel_task
description: Customer never mind. Releases the hold and bills only tracked time. Does not send the completion webhook. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Optional note. Do not include secrets.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required.

name: reopen_task
description: Send a delivery that is awaitingCustomerConfirm back to the account manager with a reason. Does not settle hours. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: What should happen next. Required. Do not include secrets.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required.

name: place_call
description: Place one human phone call. The hold is the full call: the tier minimum once, or max_minutes times the per-minute rate, whichever is higher. Default max_minutes is 5, so a tier 1 US or Canada call holds $5. Raise max_minutes on that call to hold more. record_call must be false or omitted. Only US an

arguments.name: phone
arguments.desc: US or Canada number. 801-414-4664, (801) 414-4664, and +1 801 414 4664 are accepted and stored as E.164.

arguments.name: extension
arguments.desc: Optional digits. Passed into the VA instructions. Not billed.

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: en, fil, tl, war, or ceb. Default en.

arguments.name: record_call
arguments.desc: False or omit. True is rejected: recording is not available.

arguments.name: instructions
arguments.desc: Outranks script wording. The extension is appended for the VA.

arguments.name: questions
arguments.desc: One to 20 questions. Each item is {id, ask, type?}.

arguments.name: deadline
arguments.desc: ISO-8601. Needs 60 minutes of weekday 09:00–17:00 recipient-local, unless allow_outside_business_hours is true.

arguments.name: time_window
arguments.desc: Optional 24-hour HH:MM-HH:MM in the recipient time zone. Example: 09:00-17:00. End must be after start.

arguments.name: recipient_timezone
arguments.desc: IANA zone. Omit it and TaskBullet infers a US or Canada area code. An uninferable number needs this field.

arguments.name: allow_outside_business_hours
arguments.desc: Set true only after the customer confirms the call may happen outside weekday 09:00–17:00 in the recipient time zone. The deadline then needs 60 minutes of clock time. Omit or false keeps the weekday

arguments.name: max_minutes
arguments.desc: Default 5. Maximum 60. The hold covers this many minutes.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header.

name: validate_call
description: Check a phone-call body without creating a call or placing a hold. Same fields as place_call, without idempotencyKey. name: get_call
description: Read one human phone call, including needs_info missing_fields or the final result.

name: update_call
description: Fill missing_fields on a call in needs_info. Same result shapes as place_call.

arguments.name: extension
arguments.desc: Optional digits. Passed into the VA instructions.

description: Cancel a call before the first dial and release the hold. After dialing, the current attempt finishes.

name: get_transcript
description: Read transcript.txt for one call. A cancelled call returns call_cancelled. An empty transcript returns transcript_not_ready.
